title: Polylane for Security
summary: Catch exploitable vulnerabilities before they ship
body: Polylane reviews production-bound pull requests for exploitable security flaws. Findings trace attacker-controlled input to the vulnerable line, with the evidence and suggested fix. Safe candidates are ruled out with a reason. Daily dependency scans find known CVEs, prioritise the most severe and open fix pull requests on active, deployed repositories.
